title.zh: 灵城科技 DSH 插件

description.en: DSH bundles published by Lingcheng Technology.
description.zh: 灵城科技发布的 DSH 插件。

description.en: Adds a `Provider balances and plans` entry to the left sidebar. The page lists the model providers this profile has configured, showing the DeepSeek account or API-key balance and the MiniMax token-plan 5-hour and weekly remaining percentage with reset times. Providers without a public quota API are labeled as such instead of estimated. Keys stay on this machine; the page only shows the balances and percentages the providers returned.
description.zh: 在左侧栏增加「提供商余额与套餐」入口。页面列出当前已配置的模型提供商，显示 DeepSeek 账户或 API 密钥余额，以及 MiniMax Token 套餐的 5 小时与周窗口剩余比例和重置时间。没有公开查询接口的提供商如实标注「无查询接口」，不做估算。密钥留在本机，页面只显示提供商自己返回的余额与百分比。
